tweets.full_text: TrendForce’s supply chain checks indicate that prices for NVIDIA’s server GPUs have remained largely unchanged so far this year. However, rising costs for upstream components such as HBM and wafers, combined with pressure to maintain gross margins, are creating conditions for potential GPU price increases after 1Q27. The adjustment is expected to primarily affect next year’s mainstream Rubin series. While the magnitude of any increase has yet to be announced, TrendForce initially estimates that GPU prices could rise by 10–20%.
